sentences.text: 3. FIR in Crime No.230/2023 was registered against the petitioner herein on the basis of the complaint dated 09.06.2023 lodged by Prabhu who is the father of deceased Hamsaveni.
In the complaint, it is averred that the marriage of Hamsaveni with the petitioner was solemnized about eight years prior to the date of complaint and from the wedlock, the couple have two children.
In the complaint, it is also averred that the petitioner had illicit relationship with another lady, and therefore, he was abusing and assaulting Hamsaveni.

On 08.06.2023 at about 10.00 a.m., petitioner allegedly had quarreled with his wife and thereafter, he had taken her in his motor bike and at about 11.00 a.m., on the way he made her to fall from the bike and after that allegedly assaulted on her head with a weapon and subsequently shifted her to the NC: 2023:KHC:46167 hospital where she was declared as brought dead.
It is in this background, complaint was lodged on 09.06.2023.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
Petitioner's bail application filed before the Court of I Addl. District & Sessions Judge, Chitradurga, in Crl. Misc. No.1180/2023 was dismissed on 12.10.2023.

entities.text: I Addl. District & Sessions Judge, Chitradurga
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition has prayed to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
6. As per the complaint and charge sheet allegations, petitioner allegedly had illicit relationship with another lady, and therefore, he used to quarrel with his wife.
On the date of incident, petitioner allegedly had taken his wife in his motor bike and on the way made her to fall and thereafter had assaulted on her head with a stone and had committed her murder.
7. The entire case of the prosecution is based on circumstantial evidence.

The postmortem report of the NC: 2023:KHC:46167 deceased would go to show that the deceased had suffered multiple T Shashikumara vs State Of Karnataka on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81066677/
2 injuries.

sentences.text: The said injuries are found on all parts of the body of the deceased.
In the hospital, initially history is given that the deceased had met with a road traffic accident.
The allegation against the petitioner that he had assaulted the deceased on her head with a stone after she had fallen from the bike is required to be proved in a full-fledged trial.
Petitioner has no criminal antecedents and is in custody from 09.06.2023.
Under the circumstances, I am of the view that the petitioner's prayer for grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following order:
8.
